body.title: A second session, and glass named an operating system
body.beside: The first session of 2026-11-06, weighing streams, the first time two sessions ran at once.

body.title: A site of sites
body.opens: A page laid in the field is of the field: its state navigable as a loop of a video archive, tracks placed on your own canvas and played, websites joined in a presentation that suits one's expression.

how an integration's entities are created
moulds

body.title: Glass as the OS
body.opens: A website within glass is not another origin but within the OS, read through the website itself: a native shell owning its webviews, the chassis the seam.
restsOn: where the sandbox's duty lands, in the engine and the field's declarations

body.title: Grounds coexisting
body.opens: Tab and OS as grounds of the same primitives, integration between: open-ended, groundable in various aspects, nothing preventing evolution compounding across grounds.
restsOn: the chassis as the only part that differs

body.title: What is owned, held in the bounded store
body.opens: Within the browser the local store is bounded and holds transparently owned data, bought music or video, inferred or shared data, holonically operable, with the immediacy of interface.
restsOn: integrations for media owned

body.title: Reverse re-emanation
body.opens: Once glass is birthed enough, existing software is specified by operating it under inference, as the rule was used in a closed-source project, and the mechanics shown under a group of projects.
restsOn: programs and runs
AI as programs in the field

body.title: Sharing between fields
body.opens: A platform where what is owned or shared passes between fields; its name not social media, and not commons, a word held by governance; shareship said beside ownership.
restsOn: a name not yet found

body.title: Prose to the word, by locality
body.opens: Expression held as holons down to the word: words near each other in one utterance relate more than the same word elsewhere, the near relation read from what holds them and the far one from their lexeme. This session is its first instance.
restsOn: the types of prose, drafted, not confirmed
the count of holons, now measured once

body.title: A branch as a store
body.opens: A branch is a store, and unlike git's, relational: no longer stale, still a branch, seen from the front as a whole rather than from the side as a fork; this series itself a store of its own. A valuable future development of the store.
restsOn: taking a whole away as a store
how stores relate to the stores they branched from

body.title: History anchored in public
body.opens: Not login but proof: a commit's hash set into a public chain proves a series of events was observed in a particular way from a certain point in time, and no one can mask over it after; only the hash goes public, the store stays its owner's.
restsOn: signing commits by key
which public chain, and what anchoring costs

body.title: Authority held in keys
body.opens: No backend for auth: public data encrypted to the degree the data itself is built upon, so whoever holds the key reads, and authority is in the keys and not in a server. Asked from curiosity about the nature of authority, not as a direction.
restsOn: how keys are held and given
what is encrypted, and at which holon

body.title: Pieces opened and closed
body.opens: A piece closed, then observable, then closed and observable again; invisible holons on other holons; and prose at the fidelity one is attuned to, a sentence a string or its words, recursable, a string the closed form and its holons the open one.
restsOn: whether a string is ever stored or only drawn
what is not yet in a holon: to enter, reachable, or created

body.title: Ontology in the field
body.opens: A word's meaning is only its relations within the field; on that, primitive patterns: knowledge graphs upon terms, and other components; terms perhaps not functional without something of more breadth, like symbols. Landscape, levels, holarchies and systems as one family of words.
restsOn: what a symbol is beside a term
the types of prose, drafted, not confirmed

body.title: Many branches over one held space
body.opens: A larger piece read in whole, then drawn over by isolated readers, each a branch of its own: the top of the gradient over a large quantity of holons, what matters changing with height, a steering made and then forgotten so the branches stand further apart; new ways of digesting branches made from them.
restsOn: a branch as a store
what a digest of branches is

body.title: A union of stores
body.opens: Every run and saved store read under one union, since holons are holons and the union is always divisible again by them; sessions coordinating around one available state, unintrusive by nature, each adding and none rewriting another's.
restsOn: a union as a reading of stores, not a store that moves them
the licence boundary as a store boundary

body.title: A matrix of readers
body.opens: Branches drawn across variables, model from the most basic to the highest, seed from inside or outside the held space, with unifying points held fixed across them: the same base, the same brief, the same seed across models.
restsOn: which models can be reached
a digest that reads a matrix, not a list

body.title: Statistics declared, not stored
body.opens: Everything derived over the store is a function of it: statistics declared as functional data, in prose and in expression, drawn by the interface whenever looked at and never kept as results; and a completion model that streams slots, expressions and interfaces natively, not markdown.
restsOn: functions that count and measure
streams, being specced by the first session
native prose

body.title: Sessions converge, never copy
body.opens: Each session is its own; sessions only converge, where their timelines or their holons touch, across a certain degree of order and linearity. What one says stays its own, and another meets it by reference, never by holding a copy.
restsOn: a convergence as a reference between sessions, said from either side

body.title: The store packed, carried by git
body.opens: The store stays in git, as the site publishes its field as it stands, but not as one loose file per object, which grows with every holon, nor as one file, which every publish rewrites: as packs that never change, one per commit, each holding only what that commit adds, with an index read by range from any static host; growth linear in what changes, and the first birth itself cut into commits at a realistic fidelity, since the whole is structural and its evolution topologically divisible. Files divide two ways: by ownership and wholeness, a store per whole, branch as store; and by time, a pack per commit. What may need forgetting is kept as a store of its own, apart from git until sure; a store can always be picked up, left, worked on and come back to. The birth from markdown may end here: the holons are the source now, and any birth after only produces diff-packs. Git is the carrier of the store's files, never its model.
restsOn: the file backend writing packs and their indexes
store.md and remotes.md rewritten for packs
glass not based on git, the author's of 2026-11-01

body.title: Stores that rest on stores, with a lifetime
body.opens: A store's point is sometimes not to forget but to pack up and leave: a whole that rests upon another, pointing into it, and stands when carried away, as a stream buffer does. And forgetting is allowed: lifetimes exist, and the end of a thing is decided at the point of its creation. Inference runs are large; the analysis upon them goes as deep as it goes and is made separate, and the runs beneath it may end when their lifetime does. Storage is hot and cold as well, parts of reality; a store given a real lifetime, as things are locked or expired in a bucket. A capacity for the future, pointed to, not yet built.
restsOn: a store declaring its lifetime, by contract
storage that honours it: retention and expiry
streams, being specced by the first session

body.title: A glass for the human, born from the store
body.opens: The markdown dropped but for what lets a new session digest the store in a noble manner: an entry into it and a way to read any holon back as text; and soon a new glass for human interface, an evolved experience based upon this store.
restsOn: the store code brought to the primitives as they stand
packs
an interface that reads the union
